g.text: End-to-End System Architecture: 3D SwinMamba Dual & IS-MIM Self-Supervised Learning
Unified Deep Learning Pipeline for Multi-Parametric MRI Ingestion, 3D Intra-Modality Masked Pre-training, Joint Tumor Segmentation & Glioma Grade Classification
1,251 Adult Glioma Subjects | Axial, Sag, Cor
ET ≥ 50 / TC ≥ 150 voxels → HGG (1), else LGG (0)
• Random 3D Flips along X, Y, Z axes (p=0.5)
2. SELF-SUPERVISED PRE-TRAINING PATH: INTRA-MODALITY MASKED IMAGE MODELING (IS-MIM)
T1 ↔ T1ce, T2 ↔ FLAIR pair permutations
L_MIM = Σ M ⊙ (X̂ - X)² / Σ M
3. UNIFIED HYBRID 3D SWINMAMBA DUAL BACKBONE & UNETR DECODER
[Stages 0-1: 3D Swin Local Attention | Stages 2-3: Tri-Directional Mamba SSM | Decoder: UNETR + EV2]
Conv3D (4 → 48, k=7³, s=2, p=3) + BatchNorm3D + LeakyReLU(0.01) + Dropout3D(0.05)
STAGE 0: 3D Swin Transformer (Depth=2, Dims=48, Heads=3, Win=7³)
Patch Merging 0→1: BatchNorm3D + Conv3D (48 → 96, k=2³, s=2) → [B, 96, 24, 24, 24]
STAGE 1: 3D Swin Transformer (Depth=2, Dims=96, Heads=6, Win=7³)
Patch Merging 1→2: BatchNorm3D + Conv3D (96 → 192, k=2³, s=2) → [B, 192, 12, 12, 12]
STAGE 2: GSC + Tri-Directional Mamba SSM (Dims=192, Depth=2, L=1,728)
Parallel (3×3×3 Conv) & (1×1×1 Conv) with InstanceNorm3D + ReLU + Residual Connection
Tri-Directional Selective State-Space Scans (Axial, Sagittal, Coronal):
Patch Merging 2→3: BatchNorm3D + Conv3D (192 → 384, k=2³, s=2) → [B, 384, 6, 6, 6]
STAGE 3: Deepest Mamba SSM (Dims=384, Depth=2, Sequence L=216)
Orthogonal Volumetric SSM State Size: d_state=16, d_conv=3, expand=1
Captures long-range continuous 3D context across entire patient brain space
PROGRESSIVE UNETR DECODER + EV2 RESIDUAL REFINEMENT
ConvTranspose3d (768 → 192, k=2, s=2) ⊕ Concat with skip_2 (192)
EV2Block Fusion (384 → 192): Squeeze-and-Excitation Channel Attention + Residual Conv
ConvTranspose3d (192 → 96, k=2, s=2) ⊕ Concat with skip_1 (96)
EV2Block Fusion (192 → 96): Squeeze-and-Excitation Channel Attention + Residual Conv
ConvTranspose3d (96 → 48, k=2, s=2) ⊕ Concat with skip_0 (48)
EV2Block Fusion (96 → 48): Squeeze-and-Excitation Channel Attention + Residual Conv
ConvTranspose3d (48 → 48, k=2, s=2) ⊕ Concat with skip_stem (48)
EV2Block Fusion (96 → 48): Squeeze-and-Excitation Channel Attention + Residual Conv
EV2 Residual Refinement Block (Final Decoder Feature Map)
AdaptiveAvgPool3D → FC(48→12) → ReLU → FC(12→48) → Sigmoid Channel Weights
• Channel 0: Tumor Core (TC) = Necrotic Core + Enhancing Tumor
• Channel 1: Whole Tumor (WT) = Complete Edema + Core + Enhancing
• Channel 2: Enhancing Tumor (ET) = Active Contrast Enhancement
Loss: L_seg = L_Dice (weights: TC=1.3, WT=1.0, ET=1.5) + L_Focal (α=0.25, γ=2.0)
Total Multi-Task Loss: L_total = L_seg + 0.5 · L_clf
Prunes false-positive isolated islands via anatomical thresholds:
• Overlap Accuracy: Dice Score (WT, TC, ET, and Mean Dice)
• Boundary Distance: 95th Percentile Hausdorff Distance (HD95, mm)
• Sensitivity (Recall) & Specificity across all 3 tumor subregions
• Confusion Matrix (True Positive HGG, True Negative LGG)
